message: OpenCandle replaces shallow chatbot answers with inspectable, finance-specific research across the browser and CLI.

beats.narrativeRole: Turn an opaque answer into visible finance-specific evidence, then flow directly into the real browser workflow.
beats.focalPoint: OpenCandle displacing general-purpose chatbots, revealing finance sources, and flowing into a pixel-matched browser handoff.

beats.narrativeRole: Demonstrate the complete browser workflow from a complex financial question to an inspectable answer.
beats.focalPoint: The question, visible plan, finance-specific tool results, sources, and completed response.

beats.narrativeRole: Continue inside the browser to show how the selected model, financial tool calls, sources, and answer trail work together.
beats.focalPoint: Narration-synchronized quote, SEC filing, indicator, options, and source views followed by the gpt-6 selector and completed answer.

beats.narrativeRole: Demonstrate the same transparent research workflow in the OpenCandle CLI.
beats.focalPoint: The preserved prompt, reasoning trace, and tool rows in the terminal.

beats.narrativeRole: Land user control across the browser and CLI without introducing another feature.
beats.focalPoint: The overlapping approved browser and CLI surfaces.

beats.narrativeRole: Close on inspectable financial research and one direct install action.
beats.focalPoint: OpenCandle brand followed by the install command.
